caseNameFull: B. T. Backus v. Norfolk Southern Railroad Company
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of Appeals of the State of Virginia.
attorneys: Mr. J. Edward Cole, with whom Mr. Edward R.-Baird, Jr., was on the briefs, for plaintiff in error., Mr. Jas. G. Martin for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726.
